name: Client typecheck verification
command: export PATH="$PWD/node_modules/.bin:$PATH"; node --input-type=module -e 'import {spawnSync} from "node:child_process"; import {writeFileSync} from "node:fs"; let failed=false; for (const cwd of ["packages/client-runtime", "apps/web", "apps/mobile"]) {const r=spawnSync("tsc", ["--noEmit"], {cwd, encoding:"utf8", maxBuffer:20_000_000}); const out=(r.stdout??"")+(r.stderr??""); writeFileSync("/tmp/t3-pi-"+cwd.replaceAll("/","-")+"-typecheck.log",out); console.log(cwd+" EXIT="+r.status); console.log(out.split("\n").filter(l=>l.includes("error TS")).join("\n")); failed ||= r.status !== 0;} process.exitCode=failed?1:0;'
